items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: Herbert Wright, you know who that is? ... Herbert Wright was a drummer from Charleston with the 369th

ctx.x: But Patrick's cousins and I were very very good friends, very close together, all brass men were close, and that hurt me ever so much when they said we have to -- in other words, they're saying, in other words, if Herbert Wright did what he did, it wasn't really his fault, 'cause he had a rough time coming up. Herbert Wright, you know who that is?
